# 2 Baruch Chapter 63 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 63:2 — Isaiah's role

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "who-was-a-man-of-renown and-of-great-wisdom" |
| LOGOS | "who was a man of renown and of great wisdom" |
| PNEUMA | "who was a man of great fame and wisdom" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Renown' (Syriac: shuma) carries the specific sense of established reputation/name; PNEUMA's 'fame' is acceptable but loses the more settled quality of 'renown'.

---

## 63:6 — the night of slaughter

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "in-that-night the-destroying-angel killed a-hundred-and-eighty-five-thousand" |
| LOGOS | "in that night the destroying angel killed a hundred and eighty-five thousand" |
| PNEUMA | "In that one night the destroying angel killed a hundred and eighty-five thousand" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. PNEUMA adds 'one' for emphasis, which is not in the Syriac; LOGOS renders the text accurately without embellishment.

---
